name: 8085 assignment 4
desc: This is a simple 8085 assembly language program that loads the value 23H into register A and the value 09H into register B. It then performs a bitwise AND operation on the contents of registers A and B and halts the program.

files.sketch.ino:
;. Load 23H to A register and 09H toB register. 
;AND the contents of Register A and B.

;CODE:

MVI A,23H
MVI B,09H
ANA B

HLT

; END OF CODE
